title: Ebenezer gives Johnny Depp his first number one film in eight years
summary: The film took $19 million in North America and $42 million worldwide on its opening weekend.
body:
Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol opened at number one in North America with $19 million over the weekend of 13 to 15 November.

It took a further $23 million in other countries, for a worldwide opening of $42 million. It is Johnny Depp's first number one film in eight years.

The top five

  • Ebenezer: $19 million
  • The Cat in the Hat: $11.4 million
  • Godzilla Minus Zero: $8.3 million
  • Ramayana: Rise of a Legend: $5.5 million
  • You Can See Everything: $5.4 million

Last week's number one, Godzilla Minus Zero, fell by about 73%.

Sources: Deadline, Gold Derby, Rotten Tomatoes.
